facts.text: Deborah expressed that her support is important to Jolene.

evidence.quote: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you.

facts.text: Jolene thanked Deborah for her support and mentioned she would keep her updated on the project's progress.

evidence.quote: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.

facts.text: Deborah wished Jolene to enjoy her day and prioritize things that bring her joy.

evidence.quote: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy.

facts.text: Jolene assured Deborah that she would make time for things that bring her joy and wished her a good day.

evidence.quote: I'll make sure to find time for that. Have a good one!
